english: Hey, Hasegawa. What the hell happened?
He's hopeless...
So what's this digital TV?
What's that mean?
He still looks like a killer... but he's definitely lost his energy.
Fair point.
What the hell is this?!
Calling me a bastard the second we meet, as usual? You bastard.
Shinpachi...
I'd finally found a job... then those idiots got me fired...
Y-you idiot! I've got grudges to spare!
Whose fault is that?!
Don't act like it isn't!
That's what I've been saying!
Culprit? What are you on about?
What's this about?
You wrecked my job! Why should I pay you on top of that?!
That makes no sense!
You're on! It's about time someone taught you a lesson!
Here I come, bastard!
Crap! I lost!
That's what I've said from the start...
My fault? This is MY fault?
H-hey! Wait a second... He's gone.
Hey! That bastard! When did he eat my dango?!
Yes! I win!
Of course! Justice always wins!
I told you I don't know anything!
Screw that! You're not getting away this time!
Now sit down! We're talking this through!
It's game over!
Hmm...? Oh, it's you lot...
Huh? Well... this is the toilet, right?
I've been dying to take a piss for ages...
Well... it's such a pain...
Open the door... pull out my little guy... then take aim...
Nope... Even imagining it's too much work...
Aah!!!!
What...? What was it again?
And then... huh? What happened again...?
Gin Tama? Yes, I have some. Why?
What are you saying? Gin Tama are dangerous? I don't understand...
I'm sorry, could we discuss this another time? I'm in a bit of a hurry.
I have to look after my flowers. I need to get home...
...Oh, the Yorozuya...
Huh...? Flowers...? Who cares about those...
Everything just feels like... too much work...
You lot! Don't move!
Ah, I've been waiting.
That's not why I called you here...
I found what you were looking for! Show some gratitude!
...Though I'm the one who should thank you.
That ronin tied up over there is the one who attacked you.
Saburo caught him, actually.
What now? Shall we hand these guys over to the police?
...No... Actually...
There's something else I need to tell you, lad.
Remember when Saburo ran wild? That... was my fault.
Yes, I'll explain. That's why I wanted you to come here.
You lads have Gin Tama too, right?
It's about those Gin Tama...
The truth is... I'm the one who made those things.
I was told they were high-tech toys, the latest craze on other planets.
He said he wanted to adapt them for this country and make them popular here.
And he wanted me, Edo's finest mechanic, to do it.
I don't know all the details myself...
Not just Kotodama. I converted all sorts of things into energy and packed them inside.
Whatever goes inside has to take the form of that country's words, or it won't work.
Exactly. Just as you say, lad. That's why he chose me.
Only someone like me could adapt Gin Tama for this country.
He kept flattering me, calling me the best mechanic in the country...
That's right.
No, you idiot!
Once I delivered the Gin Tama, that Amanto vanished! Not a word since!
Something was wrong. A bit late, but I took a closer look at how they worked.
And I realized... Those things could be terrifying weapons in the wrong hands!
Far too dangerous for mere toys.
I worried that Amanto had tricked me into making something truly awful.
Saburo saw me worrying and couldn't stand to sit by and watch.
He decided to gather all the Gin Tama in Edo and ran off into town on his own.
Oh... So the hostage was your sister? She had Gin Tama, didn't she?
I'm sorry about that. Please apologize to her for me.
I've asked around everywhere, but I can't find a single lead.
And get this! He hasn't even paid me the fee he promised!
Yes. 'Stick, stick, bird' reads 'Banbanji.'
Please, lad! I'm begging you! Gengai Hiraga's once-in-a-lifetime request!
Will you investigate Gin Tama and the Amanto who hired me?
You'll do it, lad?!
Thank you, lad! I owe you one!
Divine punishment!
Especially you, Gin.
That face says you found no leads... Tch. Useless.
Exactly! Tch. Useless.
See?! A thief did it! This is a clear case of robbery and murder!
What do we do?
There's no food at home, either!
He's holding something.
Forget tea and snacks. Give us a proper meal!
A robber and murderer?!
I'm hungry.
Looks tasty.
This smells like trouble!
Look! The killer-faced florist!
He really loves flowers, despite that killer face.
Can't be helped. Forcing the story forward will just make it awkward.
Game over... huh?
Weird.
She really looks like a koala.
T-that's not Big Sis!
Oh! A drag queen!
Look! The loser old man!
Nah, he's always like this!
Looks like it. Even a jobless, middle-aged loser like him wasn't THIS bad.
That's pathetic...
He's spacing out too.
It's scary either way.
You hurry up and go too, Gin!
Go, Curly!!
Hm?
Shh, Shinpachi! Keep your voice down.
Questions for me? ...About Gin Tama, I assume?
...I see. You're determined to get involved with Gin Tama after all.
Very well... Too many eyes here. Let's go down to the river.
The Shinsengumi...!
Hey, you bastard!
Shut up! Perfect timing! You know where he is, don't you?!
Katsura! Where is Katsura?!
Not THAT kind of wig!
You even know his nickname!
Not technically! We ARE the police!
Then you'll have to follow the proper procedure...
I never called him trash!
Why?!
What do you mean, 'yep'?! Don't just decide all this by yourself!
Sougo, shall we haul him in?
Sounds good! Let's have a match!
Obviously! A Gin Tama battle!
The bastard's an idiot, but he's tough! Two on one is basic strategy!
Don't come crying later!
Damn!
Damn it...
See that?! I won!
Yeah! Tell him, Sougo!
Idiot! Your problems aren't our concern! Get over here, bastard!
Oh, it's you. Loafing around in broad daylight as usual?
What are you muttering about?
Huh? Why would I?
What's this?! Accusing me in the middle of the street?!
Watch it! You might not get away with this!
Silence! You'll answer for what you just said!
Show me your balls!
Don't play dumb! Let's have a Gin Tama battle!
Are we doing this or not?
Stop trying to look cool!
You don't accuse me, then just walk off!
Enough excuses! Come on, get over here!
Game over!
Oh... Look who it is...
Did you come to visit? Sorry... we're closed today...
Exactly... I'm too tired to put on a smile for a bunch of drunks today...
Well, well. Fancy meeting you here...
Kondo, what are you planning?
Oh, really...
Why me too?
What a pain.
Looks like we lost.
Oh, wait a moment.
Now then... We won, so you can't just pretend nothing happened.
Anyway, that's how it is...
Just getting out the front door was a huge ordeal for me...
Yes... I thought I'd sell the dojo.
Work's exhausting. Sell this run-down dojo, and we can live off the money...
Dreams...? Who cares about those?
Aww, I'd just put that up! You're so mean, Shin!
Going back to my room? Ugh...
Everything's just too much work...\fAt this rate, I won't even be able to make rolled omelets. Sorry...
Don't tell me you lot are the ones who attacked him?
Just shut up for a second! You're holding up the story!
Was anything stolen?
Then what were they after?
Found Shinpachi's attacker yet?
Fan club captain! Fancy meeting you here-comes-the-soba!
translator_note: Otsu's sentence-ending wordplay adapted as English word chains.

english: Such a cute face! But that's Necrono-mean!
Gin Tama? I do... the loach dance!
No-vember! I worked hard on this collection!
Say what you want. No way-ter-melon!
What a day! The Shinsengumi took my doll by force... symme-thieves!
Yep! A kokeshi with arms and legs... yacht a cutie!
So you won't get my Gin Tama. Won-ton!
Yes! A Gin Tama battle! Let's Yosakoi!
What a disas-tonkotsu! I actually lost?!
Fine! That's all of it... smooth operator!
If I'd known, I'd have kept that doll at all costs... tank you very much!
I won! This battle's mine... rock-a-bye, baby!
I won, so I'll take your Gin Tama. Squid pro quo!
If I'd known it'd come to this, I'd never have given up that doll... Taro! Jiro!
Yeah... That might be nice too...
It's just too much...
Ugh... Sorry for worrying you, Gin...
Yes... I was going around looking for a part-time job...
